name: Wildlife Fund project grants
summary: Project grants for worldwide nature and species conservation, including endangered species work and habitat expansion for threatened wildlife. Applicants must show clear, measurable conservation impact.

amount.note: If you are requesting a higher amount, please include a well-justified and detailed budget.

status.quote: We do not currently have an open call for applications.

geography.quote: The Dierenpark Amersfoort Wildlife Fund supports initiatives worldwide that contribute to nature conservation and species protection.

access.quote: Only applications submitted through our official application form will be considered.

window.quote: Applications submitted after the deadline will not be taken into consideration.

amount.quote: Previously approved grants have ranged from €1,000 to €5,000.
